original_ERA5_wind_resource_location.description: Approximate offshore North Sea resource grid; NOT actual industrial H2 customer/electrolyser or delivery connection

official_operator_sources.title: General Terms and Conditions Connection Exit version 2.0
official_operator_sources.locator: page 4 clause 2.1.2; page 7-8 clause 4.1; page 9 clause 5.3
official_operator_sources.finding: HNS does not produce/procure gas and does not guarantee gas security of supply. Exit quality/pressure depend on Annexes 3, 12 and actual contract; HNS may close connection at low-pressure boundary.

official_operator_sources.title: Connection Exit Annex 12 Pressure Specification version 2.0
official_operator_sources.finding: Published 30-50bar(g) temporary system operating envelope; customer exit may use open-pipe network pressure or reduced fixed delivery pressure which must be specified in Contract Data Sheet. No universal minimum 20bar(a) delivered to customer.

official_operator_sources.title: Connection Exit Annex 3 Quality and Temperature Specifications version 2.0
official_operator_sources.finding: Connection quality/temperature specifications are those published by competent authority and may change; no end-use-specific impurity acceptance demonstrated.

official_operator_sources.title: Connection Exit Annex 4 Pressure and Temperature Safety — example 8 bar delivery pressure
official_operator_sources.locator: title and page 3 definitions of bar(g) up/downstream; safety mechanism figures
official_operator_sources.finding: Example of a reduced fixed-pressure connection/safety architecture, NOT evidence of actual 8bar pressure at a site, nor a guaranteed 20bar(a) product gate.

official_operator_sources.title: Connection Study Agreement template v01.26 Annex A
official_operator_sources.locator: Annex A page 1; CSA body pp. 1-3 clauses 2 and 6
official_operator_sources.finding: Requires exit/entry selection, actual customer site GPS/address and projected capacity by year in kWh/h based on 100% H2 HHV12.74 MJ/Nm3 and density0.090kg/Nm3. Template does not prove connection or tariff, and requires a site party/contractual commitments.

official_operator_sources.title: Hynetwork Contracts—customer study and connection stages
official_operator_sources.finding: Study/connection processes are not automatically available to independent computational researchers without legal site counterpart; no application has been made.

official_operator_sources.title: Connection policy for the hydrogen network
official_operator_sources.locator: Cluster prioritization, connection fee and maintenance fee sections
official_operator_sources.finding: HNS prioritizes industrial clusters, one-off connection fee plus recurrent maintenance charge; actual project capacity, tariff and fee remain unknown.
